title: CeraVe's Dune campaign took the month
detail: CeraVe's tie-in with Dune: Part Three earned about 78K Instagram likes over five posts, and CeraVe took 69% of all likes across the seven brands in the last 30 days. A film partnership with a clear product role (moisturiser for a desert planet) beat every routine and launch post.

title: Vichy posts the most but doesn't own the attention
detail: Vichy published 23 posts in 30 days, more than any competitor, yet earned 11% of all likes. La Roche-Posay matched that share with 15 posts. More posts isn't moving the needle; stronger ideas will.

title: Sensory formats beat product shots for Vichy
detail: Minéral 89 features in 6 of Vichy's last 12 Instagram posts. The best performer was the sound-on unboxing of the holiday calendar, with 2,499 likes, more than twice Vichy's average of about 1,100. Texture, sound and ritual are what people stop for.
